# VO 0.2.2
- Dictation now works while Settings is open. The microphone level meter in Settings steps aside for dictation, voice commands and meetings, says that it is paused, and comes back on its own. - Includes the 0.2.1 changes: Check for Updates in the VO menu, and the time-saved readout in days, weeks and months.

# VO 0.2.1
- Check for Updates is now in the normal VO menu at the top left of the screen, as well as the microphone menu on the right. - Includes the latest dictation, Australian English, meeting notes, speaker naming, audio review, voice coaching and Nighthawk appearance updates. - The voice output chart shows the exact date and word count when you hover over a day.
If the app still has the green appearance, open Settings → Appearance → Nighthawk for the newer look.

# VO 0.2.0
- Dictation: more hotkey choices including mouse buttons, no clipped last syllable, no double submits, Australian spelling without rewriting what you said. - Settings: named microphone picker with live level meter and test clip, clearer settings pages, updated statistics, optional Nighthawk appearance. - Meetings: records your microphone and the other side separately, fixes system audio capture, and writes notes that hold up over long meetings with decisions and action items. - Voiceprint: play clips to name each speaker, use names from the calendar invite, or mark your own voice as You. - Review and repair: timed transcript turns with audio playback, "Transcript needs review" warnings, Repair transcript, Reprocess and Redo notes. - Voice coaching: feedback on repeated starts, fast speech and pauses, with Play evidence and a short retry.
